purpose: Propose freezing the blocking dependence of the main experimental path on LLM four-family fine-tuning, and prioritizing a deterministic Claim-ID / Claim-IR output path so Kernel, planning, and certificate work are not stalled by B-tier public-family scarcity. This draft does not lower B-tier gates, admit source roles, write the effective train catalog, award credit, authorize Qwen fine-tuning, authorize downloads, or mark L2 passed.

deferred_as_non_blocking_not_revoked: Public B-tier family search and four-family LLM fine-tuning are not prerequisites for the Claim-ID/IR interface path.
Qwen or other LLM fine-tuning for multi-source semantic alignment remains unavailable without a new explicit authorization.
L2 train-quota satisfaction is not a prerequisite for interface/compiler work that only consumes normalized Claim IR packets.
not_frozen_or_erased: The A/B tier and negative-result draft remain available for supply documentation.
Future B-tier admission and optional LLM fine-tuning may be reopened only under a new explicit authorization.
Existing action-value XGBoost protocols remain separate and are not retasked by this draft.
Fail-closed, independence, privacy, anti-composite-family, and exhausted-attempt rules remain unchanged.

claim_id_ir_objective.objective: Produce a unified, machine-checkable Claim ID / Claim IR packet from declared source adapters so subsequent systems can advance without LLM fine-tuning.
minimum_output_properties: Stable claim identity rule (Claim ID assignment and collision policy).
Pointer and binding-status fields consistent with admission rules.
Admission status that can reject or mark unknown without silent promotion.
Modality and authority fields that cannot be interpreted as certified Kernel state until SI-LLM-001 shared schema is closed or an explicit provisional bridge is separately authorized.
Deterministic replay from frozen inputs and frozen adapter versions.
non_objectives: Solving general multi-lingual or multi-corpus semantic alignment by learning.
Writing LLM outputs into Kernel or E_case before shared Claim IR schema closure.

M0_rule_claim_id_compiler.goal: Ship a deterministic rule/script compiler that emits normalized Claim ID / Claim IR packets for already-approved experimental surfaces.
required_work: Publish and version an external Claim IR schema before implementation; pending_kernel_schema is a state value in that schema, not an alternate bridge protocol.
Keep Kernel ingestion and certified Kernel/E_case state writes disabled until SI-LLM-001 shared schema closure and a separate authorization.
Define Claim ID minting, deduplication, conflict-group, and admission reject rules.
Implement pure rule/script compilation for the first explicit surface allowlist: planner and certificate experiment inputs plus valid/invalid fixtures.
Provide fixtures: one valid admitted packet and one authority-leak or invalid packet that must fail.
M0_rule_claim_id_compiler.success_criterion_for_unblocking: Downstream episodes can consume rule-emitted Claim IR packets without waiting for B-tier families or LLM fine-tuning.
M0_rule_claim_id_compiler.scientific_claim_ceiling: Interface and compiler availability only; not semantic-alignment solved; not construct validity closed.

M1_multi_source_adapter_framework.goal: Integrate multiple source-type adapters behind one framework so each declared input class has a corresponding pipeline into the same Claim IR export.
required_work: Register adapter contracts per source class (mapping, modality default, failure and unknown behavior).
Keep a single admission and Claim ID policy at the hub.
Publish a coverage and failure-mode table; holds and rejects are first-class outputs.
Do not expand beyond the M0 allowlist without a separate surface-scope authorization.
M1_multi_source_adapter_framework.scientific_claim_ceiling: Source-constrained compilation framework; not a learned universal aligner.

M2_optional_xgboost_rule_residual_normal.goal: Optionally learn corrections to rule-compiler residuals with a tree model, as a controlled comparison against pure rules—not as a replacement for Qwen L2 fine-tuning dependency unless separately proven.

operating_modes.engineering_smoke_test: May check interface, determinism, and failure handling without fitting a residual model or making a scientific gain claim.
operating_modes.scientific_residual_fit: Requires a separate gold/adjudication contract, source/lineage-disjoint evaluation pack, frozen rule baseline, and explicit execute authority.

hard_separations: Must not reuse or silently retask the existing action-value XGBoost models or protocols.
Features may use only public rule-exposed match signals; no hidden recoverable sets, private gold leakage into features beyond the contracted label channel, or post-hoc quota lowering.
Requires a frozen gold or adjudicated claim set and a pre-registered metric contract before fitting.
For a scientific claim, the adjudication pack must satisfy the existing evaluative sample-kind minima or be covered by a separately justified amendment; a new arbitrary minimum is not implied here.
M2_optional_xgboost_rule_residual_normal.scientific_claim_ceiling: Residual improvement over the frozen rule baseline on the contracted label set only.

comparison_protocol.condition: Only after M0 rule baseline is frozen and an evaluation pack is pinned.

arms.description: Deterministic compiler; primary path for unblocking.
Same rules behind multi-adapter framework; evaluates coverage and operational failure modes.
Optional residual normalizer; reports delta versus rules_only only.

forbidden_comparison_practices: Starting XGBoost or framework work as an equal-priority substitute for M0.
Comparing arms on different Claim IR versions or different label packs.
Claiming semantic alignment solved from compiler throughput alone.
Using LLM fine-tuning arms in this comparison without a new authorization.

invariants_not_open_for_relaxation: Identity is not role; role is not credit; credit is not L2.
No Bypass, exhausted-attempt reuse, or silent reopen of failed acquisitions.
No writing LLM or unverified compiler output into Kernel/E_case as certified state before shared schema and admission rules allow it.
Codebook construct-validity repair remains mandatory for any human-semantic correctness claim; this path does not waive SI-level codebook issues.
Existing action-value XGBoost results must not be reinterpreted as Claim-ID alignment results.

schema.decision: Publish a versioned external Claim IR schema first; pending_kernel_schema is an explicit state value, not a bridge-only protocol.

initial_surfaces.decision: Start with the explicit planner and certificate input allowlist plus valid/invalid fixtures; do not claim repository-wide coverage.

m2_gold_pack.decision: Separate engineering smoke tests from scientific residual fitting. A scientific fit requires a new gold/adjudication contract using existing evaluative minima or a separately justified amendment, with source/lineage-disjoint splits.

paper_system_figure.decision: M0 is sufficient for an interface/compiler-unblocking figure; M1 is required for a multi-source adapter framework claim.

remaining_review_questions: Which concrete planner and certificate experiment identifiers should replace the proposed initial surface labels before implementation authorization?
Which authority will approve the separate M2 gold/adjudication contract, if a scientific residual fit is later proposed?

hard_stop.next_action: Human review of this draft. It is not effective until separately approved and committed as effective, or committed as draft-only archival. Until effective, the experimental path remains free to continue under prior authorizations, but this document recommends treating LLM four-family fine-tuning as non-blocking and prioritizing M0.
